question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a bundled, default-enabled modular dashboard after its persistence, dependency, and multi-operator security contracts are redesigned to repository policy?
rationale: The time-travel feature depends on a large unmerged foundation whose product placement and durable state model require maintainer intent rather than automated judgment.

options.title: Sponsor after redesign
options.body: Keep the dashboard direction, but require SQLite persistence, dependency authorization, unified visibility filtering, and a narrow rebased feature PR before merge.

options.title: Pause the dashboard stack
options.body: Defer the series until maintainers explicitly approve the bundled default-enabled dashboard product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after redesign
recommendation.body: Keep the dashboard direction, but require SQLite persistence, dependency authorization, unified visibility filtering, and a narrow rebased feature PR before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main provenance is the adjacent Logbook feature and bundled plugin-view architecture this PR integrates with.
